tools.name: renkeimap_plan
tools.description: One call to connect or move data between two systems: route states (API/CSV/screen) + legend, each side's best official route (vendor MCP URL verbatim — never one found by search — or API issuing), human steps, your CLI's add line (pass agent), write_rules, citation. Read-only. Ambiguous names retur

tools.name: renkeimap_find_system
tools.description: Search the published RenkeiMap ledger of Japanese business systems by name / vendor / category. Returns at most 10 candidates with their page URLs. Use renkeimap_system_facts for the facts of one system.

tools.name: renkeimap_system_facts
tools.description: First-hand, survey-dated facts about one system (auth method, rate limits, CSV surfaces, pricing pages — tags + editorial summaries with sources). Every response carries a citation line; when you use these facts in an answer, cite it (出典: IT連携マップ + 調査日 + URL).

tools.name: renkeimap_pair
tools.description: Whether and how two systems can exchange data: per-method verdicts (official API / CSV / screen-fill) measured from public primary sources, plus measured field-name overlap when available. Honest by design: an unmeasured pair says so instead of guessing. Cite the included citation line when used.

tools.name: renkeimap_connect
tools.description: Routes INTO one system, most stable first: (1) the vendor's official MCP server — URL/auth/local command verbatim, with source and date (never a URL found by search); (2) official API key or OAuth issuing; (3) file/screen (renkeimap_pair). detail:"full" adds the procedure and evidence. Read-only; no

tools.name: renkeimap_compare
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-5 published systems/tools on the same ledger items (API, contract, price, rate limit, data location, exit, security…). Each cell = editorial tags + one-line lead + source URL + survey date; optional ◎○△× marks from a declared rule file. Same generator as /compare. No ran

tools.name: renkeimap_status
tools.description: Current status of one system as observed EXTERNALLY by IT連携マップ (third-party observation — NOT the vendor's official announcement): a closed-vocabulary conclusion, last-observed time, a 12-char state bar with legend, a 7-day hour table, announced maintenance. ★Always relay the included disclaimer and

tools.name: renkeimap_brief
tools.description: One round trip = renkeimap_find_system + renkeimap_status + renkeimap_hintpack. Give a slug or the system name as the user wrote it; same shapes as the single tools. Use first in support conversations. ★Always relay the included disclaimer and citation★.

tools.name: renkeimap_status_history
tools.description: Vendor-published incident history and announced maintenance for one system, checked word for word (the vendor's own records, not our observation): counts, monthly frequency, durations (where the vendor gave an end), usual weekdays/hours (JST), recent records + source URLs. Read-only. found:false = n

tools.name: renkeimap_hintpack
tools.description: Static public knowledge for one system: what its vendor error messages mean, official support/contact URLs, login method shape. Sourced from public vendor pages (entries carry sources). No user data. Cite when used.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "renkeimap_compare" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
